create_tglfnn_transport_model: create a TGLFNN-ukaea transport model instance configured for step or multimachine operation
build_tglfnn_input_tensor_step: build a JAX input tensor from TGLF inputs for the step machine configuration
build_tglfnn_input_tensor_multimachine: build a JAX input tensor from TGLF inputs for the multimachine configuration
run_tglfnn_prediction: run the TGLFNN model prediction to compute turbulent transport fluxes from core plasma profiles
prepare_tglfnn_inputs: prepare TGLFNN neural network inputs by selecting the correct tensor format based on machine type
